strings: m_c tells r_c that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision seems to be growing blurrier and blurrier by the day. r_c looks worried at the news.

r_c tests m_c's eyesight one day, asking {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to follow r_c's tail with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes. m_c struggles with the task. r_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} it may be a permanent consequence of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head injury.

m_c only seems to grow more disoriented, despite {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head injury seeming to be fully healed. It seems {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision is blurry and slightly doubled now. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}'ll have to find a way to adjust.
